403.description: Caller lacks configure permission or is project-scoped

409.description: configuration_not_applicable: conflicts or blockers, including configuration_changed for a stale expected_digest

post.description: Changing project end-user defaults or attribution policies also requires the keys operation; unchanged policies do not. Changes to project route groups also require keys permission. Changing project aggregate budgets additionally requires keys; changing installation_budget requires settings. Unchanged policies do not require these additional scopes. Changing project limit templates also requires keys; unresolved local references prevent application. Workload issuer definitions require installation-wide access in addition to configure; this also applies to unchanged apply and replay. Identity endpoints are fetched only when newly enabled or changed, through identity egress.

200.description: Canonical secret-free configuration artifact and its digest

403.description: Caller lacks configure permission or is project-scoped

get.description: Workload issuer definitions require installation-wide access in addition to configure; this also applies to unchanged apply and replay. Identity endpoints are fetched only when newly enabled or changed, through identity egress.

200.description: Deterministic actions, conflicts and blockers; never mutates

403.description: Caller lacks configure permission or is project-scoped

post.description: Workload issuer definitions require installation-wide access in addition to configure; this also applies to unchanged apply and replay. Identity endpoints are fetched only when newly enabled or changed, through identity egress.

ConfigurationDocument.description: Secret-free desired-state artifact using natural destination identities. Code UUIDs are artifact-local references, never requested destination IDs.

exported_at.description: Informational only; excluded from the artifact digest

templates.description: Route templates; omitted when the installation declares none

installation_budget.description: Installation cap. Omitted or null preserves destination policy; an empty policy clears it. Exports always include the current policy. Changes require settings permission.

budget_time_zone.description: Requested IANA budget time zone. Export includes it. Omission/null preserves the destination. Changes require settings permission and activate independently at the next existing day/week/month boundary; current spend and calendar history remain intact.

organizations.description: Portable organization names and budgets. Memberships remain destination-local. Creation requires access; changing a budget additionally requires manage_organization and authority over that organization.

workload_issuers.description: Upserts workload trust by exact issuer URL and remaps project names. Omitted or empty preserves destination issuers; disable explicitly. Subjects, digests and signing keys are not portable. Export containing issuers, plan with issuers and apply with issuers additionally require installation access, including replay and unchanged definitions.

scim_group_mappings.description: Upsert role and project grants by group display name. Source IDs, external IDs, users and memberships stay local. Missing groups are created empty. Omission preserves destination mappings; an explicit empty grant set clears the named group. Export, plan, apply and replay containing these mappings additionally require installation Access.

require_local_mfa.description: Local sign-in second-factor requirement. Omitted/null preserves destination policy. Changes additionally require installation access authority; factors, recovery codes, challenges and sessions are never portable.

saml.description: Omission/null preserves SAML. Export, plan, apply and replay containing SAML additionally require installation access authority. Set enabled=false explicitly to disable; the usable-owner safeguard still applies.

digest.description: SHA-256 lowercase hex of the canonical document

action.description: What applying does to the item; `enroll` leaves a credential slot for grant enrollment after applying. Conflicts and blockers carry `conflict` and `blocker`.

detail.description: Qualifies the action, or names the conflict or blocker, such as `secret_binding_required`, `grant_enrollment_required`, `plugin_not_installed` or `plugin_not_approved`

key.description: Natural identity of the item: a name, slug or credential reference; a plugin's digest

provider.description: Provider name, or null for a provider-kind price

audio_input_per_million.description: Rate for the audio share of the input tokens. Omit to bill audio input at the input rate.

cached_audio_input_per_million.description: Rate for the cached share of audio input tokens. Omit to bill it at the cached input rate, then the input rate.

audio_output_per_million.description: Rate for the audio share of the output tokens. Omit to bill it at the output rate.

image_input_per_million.description: Rate for the image share of the input tokens. Omit to bill image input at the input rate.

cached_image_input_per_million.description: Rate for the cached share of image input tokens. Omit to bill it at the cached input rate, then the input rate.

image_output_per_million.description: Rate for the image share of the output tokens. Omit to bill it at the output rate.

per_request.description: A fixed fee charged once per successful attempt.

batch_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the whole usage charge of usage marked as batch. Usage marked batch with no multiplier is unpriced.

tiers.description: Input-token tiers, ascending by above_input_tokens. The highest exceeded tier replaces the entry's per-million rate set.

training_per_million.description: Exact currency rate per million training tokens.

storage_per_gib_day.description: Exact currency rate per GiB-day; GiB is 2^30 bytes.

cache_storage_per_million_token_hour.description: Exact currency rate per million cached token-hours.

container_per_session.description: Exact per-session rates keyed by native memory tier, for example 1g or 4g.

end_user_defaults.description: Portable per-end-user defaults. Destination-local digest overrides and blocks are preserved.

attribution_policy.description: Portable project attribution requirements and pinned defaults. Changing this policy additionally requires keys authorization.

route_groups.description: Portable project route groups. Omitted, null or empty removes groups. Changes require keys permission as well as configure.

budget.description: Aggregate project cap. Omitted or null clears caps without resetting spend; changes require keys permission.

limit_templates.description: Omitted/null preserves destination templates; an empty object clears unused templates. Changes require keys as well as configure. Referenced templates cannot be removed.

end_user_limit_template.description: Project limit-template name. Every non-null template dimension is a ceiling; inline limits may only tighten it. Updates propagate at authority refresh. Null detaches the reference.

attribution_budgets.description: Portable project label/value caps. Omitted/null/empty clears caps without resetting accounting. Changes additionally require keys permission.

organization.description: Organization name. Omitted/null preserves destination membership. First assignment requires installation access authority; existing membership cannot change.

public_catalog.description: Owner-enabled anonymous catalog. Changing this value through promotion requires installation access scope.

public_catalog_prices.description: Independent opt-in for published catalog prices.

expected_digest.description: Digest the destination must still export for the apply to proceed

secret_bindings.description: Write-only map from credential_ref to secret; never echoed, audited, or replayed. A slot a grant backs takes no binding.

external_credential_bindings.description: Destination bindings for logical credential references. Stored without resolved values; new versions must pass validation before activation. A name cannot also appear in secret_bindings. Introducing an external reference requires installation-wide settings authority in addition to configure authority.

network_credential_ref.description: Portable secret binding name, conventionally provider name followed by /network. Export omits runtime network credential UUIDs; supply this reference through secret_bindings when applying the artifact.

project.description: Project name, or null for an installation-wide provider
Project name, or null for an installation-wide route

fidelity.description: Omit, or send null, to declare a strict route.

fallbacks.description: Ordered routes to continue on for the named conditions. The graph must be acyclic, inside one project, at most three routes deep, and strict routes may fall back only to strict routes.

selectors.description: Ordered request selectors; the first match wins.

budget.description: Spend cap of the route itself.

max_body_bytes.description: Optional ingress limit in bytes. Null inherits installation limits; a route can only lower them. Checks both encoded and decoded JSON, the complete multipart body, and individual client WebSocket messages. Published revisions pin this policy.

caller_cost_exempt.description: Caller-paid ingress route (default false). Requires caller credentials on every foreground target and equal policy on fallback/selector routes. Usage and prices remain recorded, and rate/token/concurrency limits remain enforced; caller attempts are excluded from USD budget admission and accrual. Operator-authenticated probes, shadows and independently admitted classifiers retain their own budgets.

provider_fetched_documents.description: Allow the bound provider to fetch https document URLs named by callers on this route (default false). The gateway never fetches document bytes itself.

expose_upstream_models.description: Explicitly disclose upstream model names in route catalogs.

passthrough.description: Governed pass-through binding; null or omitted for ordinary routes. A pass-through route serves only the passthrough operation with exactly one non-shadow target and one attempt, and rejects fallback, mirroring, translation, response caching and guardrails at plan and publication.

tool_execution.description: When gateway, the gateway executes authorized read-only tools on transformed Chat Completions routes.

toolsets.description: Published toolset IDs that gateway execution may use. Callers can select a subset.

responses_mcp_items.description: Operator declaration that Responses clients support gateway-generated MCP output items. Requires gateway tool execution on a transformed route. MCP items are emitted only when the run uses the certified built-in Responses contract; other contracts omit them.

credential_ref.description: Stable 'provider-name/slot-name-or-default' reference to the slot's credential; null for credentialless authentication. Every slot of a provider that authenticates with a grant has one: exports never carry grant material, and importing leaves the slot for grant enrollment.

daily_cost_limit.description: Exact decimal amount in the installation currency.

monthly_cost_limit.description: Exact decimal amount in the installation currency.

saturation_percent.description: Usage percentage of the quota above which each class is held to its share.

ConfigurationTemplateEntry.description: A route template keyed by name. Applying stores it; provider activation and the template's apply operation generate its routes.

project.description: Project name, or null for an installation-wide template

match.description: Exact string matches at JSON pointers. The first matching mapping wins; an empty object matches all verified subjects.

project.description: Project name in the document or destination.

agent_principal.description: Allow this mapping to authenticate an agent principal. Exact subject and client claims are required.

ConfigurationWorkloadMapping.description: Owner-declared permissions, never project or template names chosen freely by the token. A registered subject stays bound to its first matching name/project.

ConfigurationSAML.description: Portable public SAML trust and role mappings. Promotion creates or preserves a destination-local SP signing key and certificate; link state, subjects, flows, sessions and private material never travel.

credential_ref.description: Deterministic exported logical signing reference; destination bytes are supplied separately.

catalog_digest.description: Reviewed tool catalog. Destination certification must match before configuration changes commit.

credential_ref.description: Logical destination sealed bearer binding; never source credential bytes.

unit_price.description: Unit price for each dispatched tool call in the installation pricing currency, with no currency conversion. Null means unpriced, which refuses dispatch while an enforced budget ceiling applies. An explicit 0 is a known free price. The price is pinned by the certified server revision.

tool_prices.description: Per-tool unit prices keyed by certified tool name, in the installation pricing currency. A tool price overrides the server unit price for that tool.

calls_per_minute.description: Dispatched calls per minute allowed against this server across all keys. Defaults to 60 and stays inside installation limits.

max_concurrency.description: Concurrent dispatched calls allowed against this server across all keys. Defaults to 8 and stays inside installation limits.

per_key_calls_per_minute.description: Dispatched calls per minute allowed for one API key against this server. Defaults to 60 and stays inside installation limits.

per_key_max_concurrency.description: Concurrent dispatched calls allowed for one API key against this server. Defaults to 8 and stays inside installation limits.

credential_ref.description: Portable secret binding name, provider name followed by /billing; supply the credential through secret_bindings.

published_credential_ref.description: Independent published-agent credential binding; never inherit a draft credential across endpoints.

project_id.description: Optional source identity; promotion resolves the owning project by name.

key_grants.description: Exact project-local API-key names resolved independently in the destination. Missing or ambiguous keys block promotion.

extra_usage_enabled.description: Whether the member Extra Usage paid fallback setting is on for a Kimi Code account. Null means not recorded.

max_body_bytes.description: Optional ingress limit in bytes. Null inherits installation limits; a route can only lower them. Checks both encoded and decoded JSON, the complete multipart body, and individual client WebSocket messages. Published revisions pin this policy.

messages_to_codex.description: Explicitly allow Messages text and tool requests to use Codex subscription accounts through protocol translation. Published revisions pin this policy. Native forwarding remains the default. Translation alone preserves client identity and prompts. Codex identity compatibility requires its separate codex_cli_identity opt-in. Model rewriting requires its separate opt-in. Explicit low, medium and high reasoning effort is supported. Signed thinking, numeric reasoning budgets, beta features and unsupported required semantics are refused before dispatch.

aliases.description: Stable public model names mapped directly to one native identifier in models. Requires model_rewriting. Alias chains and native name collisions are rejected. Immutable publications pin these mappings. Repointing an alias affects new conversations. Existing conversations retain their stored exact target while it remains published and authorized.

model_rewriting.description: Explicitly enable model identifier rewriting through exact aliases or configured model_pools. Disabled by default. This policy does not rewrite client identity or prompts.

initial_recovery_attempts.description: Maximum additional attempts per request for a new or established single-pin root conversation after an adapter proves nonexecution and the complete input is portable. Zero disables recovery. Published revisions pin this policy. Existing children, socket ownership and unresolved attempts prevent migration. Exact models remain the default. Only explicit model_pools authorize model changes. Live authority remains required. Producing-account reference ownership is preserved. Accepted, partial, ambiguous and opaque work never replays.

model_pools.description: Explicit subscription model recovery pools keyed by a published native name or exact alias. Requires model_rewriting. Each ordered list starts with that name's normal exact target and contains distinct native identifiers from models. Recovery prefers the pinned exact target, then these alternatives, within initial_recovery_attempts and positive nonexecution, portability, live authorization and budget checks. Omitted pools preserve exact selection. Publications freeze the policy. Existing conversations retain their exact target, including after alias changes, while it remains published and authorized. Paid fallback is separately governed.

chat_to_antigravity.description: Explicit opt-in for chat translation through the Antigravity adapter.

paid_fallback_targets.description: Explicit recovery-only paid targets keyed by native model, using the same named destination provider, slot and credential bindings as direct paid targets. Requires paid participation and a positive initial recovery limit.

codex_cli_identity.description: Explicit route-administrator opt-in, disabled by default and independent of protocol translation. On Codex subscription HTTP and WebSocket requests only, fills Originator with codex_cli_rs when every supplied Originator value is absent or blank. Preserves explicit Originator values, User-Agent, all prompts, tools, reasoning, state and other headers. Does not enable translation or prompt changes. Publication freezes the policy. Using subscription accounts through this compatibility identity may violate provider terms and risk account suspension. Review this behavior and risk before enabling and publishing.

chat_to_codex.description: Explicit Chat text and function tool translation through Codex Responses, disabled by default and pinned by publication. Native forwarding remains the default. Low, medium and high reasoning effort is supported. Required signed reasoning, media, server-owned state and unsupported semantics are refused. Independent Codex identity and model rewriting policies remain separate. Current OpenCode client and live subscription acceptance remain unqualified.

ConfigurationCode.description: Resource IDs are artifact-local references. Accounts resolve through explicitly bound current destination enrollments. Pools and budgets reuse validated same-project artifact IDs or standard UUIDv5 destination IDs derived from project, resource kind and artifact reference, with unique natural matches as fallback. This preserves duplicate names and exact duplicate budgets without a registry. Routes resolve through unique slug. Unrelated ambiguous identities are refused. Source credentials, health, usage windows, conversation bindings and historical revisions stay local. Destination projects and providers must be prepared and enrolled before planning. Rename globally unique slugs for same-installation cross-project promotion.

ConfigurationDiscountEntry.description: A discount scope the document prices under. Scopes the document omits are left unchanged.

provider.description: Provider name the discount is scoped to; omitted for a provider-kind scope

organization.description: Organization name, required when kind is organization

project.description: Project name, required when kind is project

ConfigurationRateCardEntry.description: One owner's charge terms. Cards the document omits are left unchanged.
